# Roadmap

`roadmap` draws a lightweight, sinuous path through a set of semantic roadmap items. The horizontal layout alternates cards above and below the path; the vertical layout keeps the cards readable while the road gently bends through the marker gutter.

Horizontal roadmaps automatically switch to the vertical layout on narrow screens.

## Horizontal

```markdown
::: {.roadmap orientation="horizontal" curve="0.6"}

::: {.roadmap-item title="Research" status="done"}
Review references and define requirements.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Prototype" status="done"}
Build the first working version.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Validation" status="current"}
Test the component with real documents.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Release" status="milestone"}
Publish the stable version.
:::

:::
```

::: {.roadmap orientation="horizontal" curve="0.6"}

::: {.roadmap-item title="Research" status="done"}

## Vertical with numbered markers

```markdown
::: {.roadmap orientation="vertical" markers="numbers" curve="0.75"}

::: {.roadmap-item title="Collect" status="done"}
Gather the source material.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Process" status="current"}
Transform and validate the data.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Review" status="future"}
Review the result.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Publish" status="milestone"}
Publish the final output.
:::

:::
```

## Theme-aware colors

Every exposed color follows the extension-wide fallback convention: an unsuffixed value applies to both themes, while `-light` and `-dark` override it only in the corresponding mode.

```markdown
::: {.roadmap
  road-color-light="#64748b"
  road-color-dark="#94a3b8"
  point-color-light="#2563eb"
  point-color-dark="#60a5fa"
  surface-color-light="#ffffff"
  surface-color-dark="#212529"}

::: {.roadmap-item title="Plan" status="done"}
Define scope and dependencies.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Build" status="current"
  point-color-light="#7c3aed"
  point-color-dark="#c4b5fd"}
Implement the component.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Ship" status="future"}
Release it.
:::

:::
```

::: {.roadmap road-color-light="#64748b" road-color-dark="#94a3b8" point-color-light="#2563eb" point-color-dark="#60a5fa" surface-color-light="#ffffff" surface-color-dark="#212529"}

::: {.roadmap-item title="Plan" status="done"}
Define scope and dependencies.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Build" status="current" point-color-light="#7c3aed" point-color-dark="#c4b5fd"}
Implement the component.
:::

::: {.roadmap-item title="Ship" status="future"}
Release it.
:::

:::

## Options

| Option | Values / meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `curve` | number from `0` to `1` | `0.6` |
| `markers` | `dot`, `numbers`, `none` | `dot` |
| `road-width` | CSS length | `3px` |
| `road-background-width` | CSS length | `10px` |
| `point-size` | CSS length | `14px` |
| `road-color` | road color | automatic |
| `point-color` | marker color | automatic |
| `surface-color` | card/marker surface | automatic |

`road-color`, `point-color`, and `surface-color` also accept `-light` and `-dark`. Individual `.roadmap-item` blocks can override `point-color`, `point-color-light`, and `point-color-dark`.

Item statuses are `done`, `current`, `future`, and `milestone`.

## PDF and DOCX

The SVG road is an HTML enhancement. In PDF and DOCX, the component becomes a normal ordered list and keeps item titles, statuses, and content readable and editable.
